Class GamePrinter

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.View.TUI.GamePrinter
public final class GamePrinter extends Object
Utility class (static methods only) to print the state of Mesos in text mode. Unknown Scanner or interaction: every method translates a piece of GameDTO into output to System.out. TuiView composes these building blocks to construct the screens.

Offer tile icons

The content of the seven offer tiles (A..G) is fixed by the rules, so the icons are hardcoded here and not read at runtime from offer_tiles.json: the client must work even without access to server resources. 
  A → F+3  (3 food reward, 5 players)
  B → ↓    (1 pick lower)
  C → ↑    (1 pick upper)
  D → ↓↓   (2 pick lower, 3+ players)
  E → ↓↑   (1 lower + 1 upper)
  F → ↑↑   (2 pick upper)
  G → ↓↑↑  (1 lower + 2 upper, 4+ players)

  • Method Details

    • printBoard

      public static void printBoard(GameDTO g, String myNickname)
      Complete board printout.

      Layout logic (mirrors the physical board): tribe cards (CHARACTER + EVENT) occupy UPPER and LOWER on the left, where LOWER contains what was in UPPER in the previous round. Buildings (BUILDING), which the model keeps mixed in the same lists, are filtered and shown separately in the BUILDING section (on the right).

    • printTurnOrderTrack

      public static void printTurnOrderTrack(List<PlayerDTO> order)
      Prints the Turn Order track: the sequence of players (1st = leftmost, acts first next round). Drawing this is essential — without it the player cannot reason about who will move next or whether they will pay the food cost on the last slot of tile A.

    • printTribe

      public static void printTribe(GameDTO g, String nickname, boolean hideInventorIcon)
      Prints a player's tribe, with optional masking of the Inventor icon.

      CLAUDE.md §11.2 / §11.4 mandate that the Inventor icon must remain hidden from other players until the final scoring (i.e. GAME_OVER). Pass hideInventorIcon = true when displaying an opponent's tribe before the end of the game.

    • printRowDetails

      public static void printRowDetails(String label, List<CardDTO> cards)
      Detailed view of a row (UPPER or LOWER). Filters BUILDING: in upper/lower rows only tribe cards are shown (CHARACTER + EVENT). For building details use printBuildingsDetails(GameDTO).
